items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: And this is why Paul Vaughan used to tell me about, if you're going to have a band, try to get seasoned musicians.

ctx.x: will always be different. What about some different arrangements that he had? And did you record any of those arrangements? No, we didn't record them. See, we didn't have tape recordings. No recordings? No recordings. You never recorded with

all of them at all? No, we didn't record the whole time that I was with him. We had a session to go to New York to record. But he never did have the band that Joe Glazer wanted. The band had changed the style. And this is why Paul Vaughan used to tell me about, if you're going to have a band, try to get seasoned musicians. So your style can be standard. Because you couldn't take a man like King Oliver's style and make a progressive band out of it. And playing with King, unless it was the whole ensemble playing…

Did you ever broadcast on WSAZ? Where was that? I think that was in Huntington. Probably that, probably so. I don't remember the call. You don't remember the call. That was like W-M-M-N. That's in Fairmont, West Virginia.
